correctness.rationale: Conditioning on one independently chosen parent and coupling future descendants gives Cov(1{P_t=j},L_n)=n(1+H_{j-1}-H_{t-1})/[t(t-1)]. Telescoping yields the exact mixed covariance; a rational neighboring difference proves one sign transition; reciprocal-square expansion locates it asymptotically. A companion program independently exhausts every tree of up to eight vertices.
